description: Worker status heartbeat that the worker sidecar publishes on sie.health.<worker_id> and the gateway reads as WorkerStatusMessage. The sidecar publishes exactly `fields`, leaving out an `omitted_when_empty` field whose value is empty. A reader treats every missing field as its default.

omitted_when_empty.unsupported_models: Routable model ids (model or model:profile) covered by bundle_config_hash that this worker cannot serve. Workers that predate the field never send it and serve every model their hash covers, so a missing list means empty.
